build_augmentation: build a DensePose augmentation pipeline with random rotation for training data
create_DatasetMapper: create a DatasetMapper instance to transform dataset dictionaries for DensePose training
transform_densepose_annotations: transform DensePose annotations by applying image transforms and validating data
add_densepose_masks_as_segmentation: add DensePose coarse segmentation masks as bitmask segmentation for instance annotations
map_dataset_dict: map a dataset dictionary through the DatasetMapper to produce model-ready input tensors
